tests.description: Five controlled SDK/converter integration regressions for DW-39; no live server calls.

playwright_utils_deviations.reason: SDK global.fetch injection is required to exercise installed SDK response parsing before production classification/conversion; apiRequest would bypass that boundary. It returns only in-memory controlled Responses and issues no remote request.

confidence.evidence: Current SDK createClient options and PostgrestBuilder.processResponse inspected; pre-generation controlled probe preserved null, blank, whitespace, omitted and numeric message values. Full direct converter matrix already covered by 84 tests.
limits: Generated tests do not execute EventsService or prove live PostgREST behavior.

Merged auto network monitor requires Chromium even for these API cases.

summary: Generated 5 API boundary tests: 2 P1 and 3 P2. SDK parses controlled HTTP400 Responses before the actual classifier/converter. Existing unit tests own the full fallback matrix. No auth session, persistent data, or remote API is used. No schema exists for malformed envelopes. One documented SDK-fetch deviation; no Pact artifacts because the relevance gate is closed.
